import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] M1 = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] M2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] dis = new int[12][12];
    static boolean[][] mark = new boolean[12][12];
    static final int MAXN = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] dr = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dc = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static boolean[][][][] dp = new boolean[72][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] reachable = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] cap = new int[290][290];
    static int[] prevNode = new int[290];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[290];

    static class Pos {
        int r, c;
        Pos(int r, int c) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static void bfs_dis(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], INF);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(mark[i], false);
        }
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        mark[sr][sc] = true;
        dis[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new Pos(sr, sc));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = cur.r + dr[i];
                int nc = cur.c + dc[i];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < n && nc >= 0 && nc < n && !mark[nr][nc] && Character.isDigit(M1[nr][nc])) {
                    mark[nr][nc] = true;
                    dis[nr][nc] = dis[cur.r][cur.c] + 1;
                    q.offer(new Pos(nr, nc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean findAugmentingPath() {
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Arrays.fill(prevNode, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        visited[0] = true;
        q.offer(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (u == 2 * n * n + 1) return true;
            for (int v = 0; v <= 2 * n * n + 1; ++v) {
                if (cap[u][v] > 0 && !visited[v]) {
                    visited[v] = true;
                    prevNode[v] = u;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void mainLogic() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            M1[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            M2[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        int sr = sc.nextInt();
        int scPos = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (M1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sr = i;
                    scPos = j;
                }
            }
        }
        bfs_dis(sr, scPos);
        for (int i = 0; i < 72; ++i) {
            for (int pr = 0; pr < n; ++pr) {
                for (int pc = 0; pc < n; ++pc) {
                    for (int r = 0; r < n; ++r) {
                        Arrays.fill(dp[i][pr][pc][r], false);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(M1[i][j])) {
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int step = 0; step < t; ++step) {
            for (int pr = 0; pr < n; ++pr) {
                for (int pc = 0; pc < n; ++pc) {
                    for (int r = 0; r < n; ++r) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < n; ++c) {
                            if (!dp[step][pr][pc][r][c]) continue;
                            if (dis[r][c] <= step) continue;
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                                int nr = r + dr[k];
                                int nc = c + dc[k];
                                if (nr >= 0 && nr < n && nc >= 0 && nc < n && Character.isDigit(M1[nr][nc]) && dis[nr][nc] >= step + 1) {
                                    dp[step + 1][pr][pc][nr][nc] = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int pr = 0; pr < n; ++pr) {
            for (int pc = 0; pc < n; ++pc) {
                for (int r = 0; r < n; ++r) {
                    Arrays.fill(reachable[pr][pc][r], false);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int step = 0; step <= t; ++step) {
            for (int pr = 0; pr < n; ++pr) {
                for (int pc = 0; pc < n; ++pc) {
                    for (int r = 0; r < n; ++r) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < n; ++c) {
                            if (dp[step][pr][pc][r][c]) {
                                reachable[pr][pc][r][c] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 290; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(M1[i][j])) {
                    cap[0][i * n + j + 1] = M1[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(M2[i][j])) {
                    cap[n * n + i * n + j + 1][2 * n * n + 1] = M2[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (!Character.isDigit(M1[i][j])) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; ++l) {
                        if (!Character.isDigit(M1[k][l])) continue;
                        if (!reachable[i][j][k][l]) continue;
                        cap[i * n + j + 1][n * n + k * n + l + 1] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        while (findAugmentingPath()) {
            int f = INF;
            for (int u = 2 * n * n + 1; u != 0; u = prevNode[u]) {
                f = Math.min(f, cap[prevNode[u]][u]);
            }
            for (int u = 2 * n * n + 1; u != 0; u = prevNode[u]) {
                cap[prevNode[u]][u] -= f;
                cap[u][prevNode[u]] += f;
            }
        }
        int maxFlow = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * n * n + 1; ++i) {
            maxFlow += cap[i][0];
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        mainLogic();
    }
}
